capabilities: Snapshot the vault to Dropbox on a schedule
Deduplicate identical files with content-addressed storage
Prune old snapshots with hierarchical retention tiers
Browse snapshots and restore individual files
Recover files with a standalone Node CLI
disambiguation: Not a note-archiving or read-later tool; it backs up vault files to Dropbox and restores them.
extras: Backups are stored as content-addressed blobs and manifests rather than plain files, so recovery goes through the in-app browser or the bundled Node CLI; the README asks users to keep a second independent backup until 1.0.
intentEvidence: There's another Obsidian community plugin that also backs up to Dropbox: Aut-O-Backups by ryanpcmcquen
problem: Whole-vault snapshots and syncing tools make it hard to recover one note's earlier version after an accidental delete, bad merge or overwrite.

relations.evidence: There's another Obsidian community plugin that also backs up to Dropbox: Aut-O-Backups by ryanpcmcquen

summary: Versioned vault backup plugin that snapshots notes to Dropbox with content-addressed deduplication, tiered retention and per-file restore.
